name: Get Off My Island
desc:
A silly game about using bats with different abilities to knock each other off the island.

📊 4 different stats to upgrade.
💰 Earn Coins to buy 25+ unique bats.
⚔️ No ability cooldown. (Very chaotic)
⏰ Defeat others to steal their time.

🚨Private Servers are FREE🚨

🔥 500 likes for next code 🔥
